nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: Three Moorfolk stand in the broken doorway, slime on their boots and dead Mana Orbs at their belts. All three orbs are glowing.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: I saw the lights come on when you moved. Every lamp in the vault, and then our orbs.

nodes.speaker: class-cleric
nodes.line: Nobody has slept in these tanks since Halcyon fell. Nobody was supposed to wake up in one.

nodes.speaker: class-barbarian
nodes.line: There'll be more slimes on the stair, drawn by the leak. We can talk at the top.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: Whatever you are, our orbs work near you. Come with us.
